elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly imposes an O&M Costs commitment on Teleglobe USA Inc., although it limits and permits reduction of that commitment.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Payment is based on Teleglobe USA Inc.'s proportionate share of O&M Costs actually incurred, not solely on usage or Services ordered.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The commitment is expressly limited to the then-current twelve-month period commencing on the RFS Date and each anniversary.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Teleglobe USA Inc. may reduce the commitment on thirty days' prior written notice.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Any reduction or shortfall is trued up to actual O&M Costs, and no penalty, forfeiture, capacity reclamation, or acceleration applies to the reduced amount.
